mapper.sql: r.is_delete = 0 and r.publish_status = 1 and p.is_delete = 0 and p.partner_status = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from basket_partner_support_record r inner join basket_partner p on p.id = r.partner_id where
select ifnull(sum(r.support_amount), 0) from basket_partner_support_record r inner join basket_partner p on p.id = r.partner_id where and r.support_type = 'CASH' and r.support_amount is not null

select r.id as recordId, p.id as partnerId, p.partner_name as partnerName, lf.access_url as partnerLogoUrl, p.website_url as websiteUrl, r.support_type as supportType, r.support_amount as supportAmount, date_format(r.support_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as supportDate, r.public_description as publicDescription from basket_partner_support_record r inner join basket_partner p on p.id = r.partner_id left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = p.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0 where order by r.sort_order desc, r.support_date desc, r.create_time desc, r.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
